title: He built Jarvis from Iron Man in real life! Follow @tankots42 and @wisprflow on Instagram for more.
description:
Tanay Kothari built Jarvis from Iron Man in real life. But not exactly...

He's always wanted to build Jarvis, since his childhood, he's learnt coding, built 50+ apps, stayed up late nights to do all these things just because of that one dream.

All that in his childhood built the foundation for him to be able to actually do it with a team.

He built Jarvis but in real life. But in devices, it's a super smart voice assistant that actually understands you and does things for you on your device screen...

#ironman #screen #inspiration #irl #jarvis #tech #coding #founder #technology #ceo #entrepreneur #ai #mindset #business #startup #device #obsession #story #aitools #motivation
